Noida/Bengaluru
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking an experienced Principal Transport Modeller to lead the development, analysis, and delivery of strategic transport modelling projects. The role requires technical expertise in PTV VISUM and SATURN, strong analytical capability, and proven leadership in guiding teams through complex modelling and forecasting assignments. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping transport strategies, supporting infrastructure design, and delivering high quality modelling outputs to clients across the public and private sectors.
  
  
As a member of our modelling team, you will be supported by experienced colleagues to deliver against applicable industry guidelines and standards. You will be integrated into our global business, offering fantastic opportunities for your career to develop. In turn you will be expected to help support and develop junior colleagues.
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate will have:
  

* Thorough knowledge of transport modelling concepts including Highway modelling, Public Transport Systems, Variable Demand Modelling and various traffic assignment techniques and be skilled in the development of robust models to support decision-making.
* 12-15 years of experience of modelling software such as SATURN, EMME or CUBE, DIADEM and associated modelling tools with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in modelling with PTV VISUM.
* In-depth experience of developing and managing highway and public transport models from first principles including understanding of elements such as model procedure sequence, network coding, demand matrix development, and scenario forecasting.
* Proven track record in developing, calibrating, validating, and updating National Highways and National Transport Authority (NTA) Regional Models—with the ability to lead complex model development workflows, zoning system updates, and network enhancements.
* Understanding of wider transport appraisal processes, including economic assessment (e.g. TUBA), accident analysis (COBALT), and environmental assessment inputs.
* Experience in survey data analysis strong analytical, problem solving, and quality assurance capabilities.
* Be committed to providing high-quality, affordable and innovative solutions and advice to clients and have good report writing, project management, supervisory, communication and technical ability.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Understanding of Standards and guidelines in UK and Ireland. e.g. DfT, UK TAG, TAF (Ire), TII PAG (Ire)
* Strategic insight and a proactive approach to improving modelling processes and outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of strategic multimodal modelling projects (highway and public transport models).
* Manage modelling projects including survey programmes, model development, calibration, validation, demand matrix development, forecasting and economic appraisal.
* Manage and deliver Variable Demand Modelling (VDM) processes and ensure model robustness, consistency, and compliance with relevant modelling guidance.
* Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, develop inputs, and support modelling decisions using Python, Power BI, VB, and other analytical tools.
* Check outputs for compliance with quality requirements and industry best practice and motivate others to do so as well.
* Integrate modelling outputs with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS, MapInfo, and QGIS, supporting spatial analysis, mapping, and visual communication of results.
* Provide modelling support for Traffic Impact Assessments and the design and appraisal of transport infrastructure schemes.
* Produce high quality technical documentation such as Base Year Validation Report, Forecasting Report, Data Processing Report, Demand Matrix Development Report.
* Lead project planning activities, including task scheduling, scoping, initiation, and execution planning.
* Contribute to business development activities including proposal preparation.
* Collaborate effectively with multi-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with client teams and remote counterparts, ensuring alignment across project workstreams.
* Mentor, train, and support junior modellers, ensuring they develop strong modelling, reporting, and analytical skills.
* Provide guidance and training to other modelling resources to ensure project delivery and staff / team development
* Promote best practice in modelling methodology, data governance, and project delivery.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, technical reviews, and continuous improvement within the modelling team.

**Desirable Skills And Additional Competencies**

* Expertise in GIS packages such as ArcMap, QGIS or MAPINFO.
* Knowledge of Python, SQL and other programming languages.
* Knowledge of microsimulation software such as VISSIM, PARAMICS and AIMSUN.
* Ability to identify and resolve complex technical or design challenges with innovative, evidence based solutions.
* Awareness of emerging trends, modelling technologies, and best practices in transport planning, ensuring modern and future proof approaches to modelling.
* Collaborate on conference papers and get involved in internal knowledge share webinars.
* Ability to work across disciplines to integrate transport modelling with land use planning, urban design, and policy development.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, or a related discipline..
* Achieved or actively working towards post-graduate qualification (TPP, CEng etc.)

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
**ole Overview**

The Data Warehouse Engineer serves as the primary technical lead for the Snowflake data warehousing ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing scalable data models, managing Snowflake environments, optimizing performance and cost, enforcing security policies, and supporting analytics and enterprise reporting platforms, including Business Objects (BIC), across the organization. The DW Engineer ensures that Snowflake is stable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards, and collaborates with Platform Administrators and third‑party vendors to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of issues impacting reporting availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design enterprise‑level Snowflake models including conformed dimensions, fact tables, and semantic views.
* Document ERDs, modeling assumptions, and physical/logical architectures.
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and performance optimization patterns.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Build advanced SQL transformations across all Snowflake layers.
* Implement automated workflows using Tasks, Streams, procedures, and time‑based orchestration.
* Support schema evolution and large‑scale data integration patterns.

**Environment & Release Management**

* Coordinate Snowflake schema and object deployments via Git or CI/CD pipelines.
* Own release readiness for Snowflake across Dev, Test, and Prod.
* Ensure new models, views, RBAC changes, and stored procedures are validated prior to promotion.

**Performance Optimization**

* Conduct performance tuning through micro‑partition analysis, clustering, query plan reviews, and caching strategies.
* Implement Resource Monitors, usage alerts, and proactive performance dashboards.
* Review warehouse utilization to ensure compute resources are right‑sized and cost‑optimized.

**Security, RBAC & Controls**

* Design and maintain Snowflake role hierarchies, object privileges, row‑level security, and masking policies.
* Support audit requests, compliance checks, and evidence gathering for reviews.
* Govern secure internal and external data sharing.

**Cost Management**

* Produce recurring consumption reports to support conduct cost optimization analysis.
* Recommend improvements in warehouse sizing, retention policies, storage optimization, and compute scheduling.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) IRC306872
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a high-caliber Principal / Lead Cloud AI Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern Enterprise AI paradigms. In this hybrid hands-on and customer-facing role, you will lead the architecture, design, and deployment of scalable microservices, distributed systems, and cutting-edge GenAI/Agentic solutions.
  
  
You will own the complete solution lifecycle—from direct client discovery and architectural design to hands-on implementation and production deployment—translating complex, ambiguous business problems into secure, high-performance Cloud AI systems.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Core Development Track (Python or Java)

Strong, hands-on enterprise-level expertise in EITHER Python OR Java (Tracks are evaluated separately; expertise in at least one is mandatory).
  
  
Proven track record building enterprise microservices, REST APIs, and distributed event-driven applications.
  
  
  

* Technical & Cloud Architecture

Deep technical knowledge of distributed system design, enterprise application integration, and relational/non-relational database technologies.
  
  
Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) core services: Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.
  
  
Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and enterprise CI/CD automation pipelines.
  
  
  

* GCP AI & Machine Learning Ecosystem

Hands-on proficiency in building and deploying models via Vertex AI and integrating foundation models via the Gemini API.
  
  
Demonstrated experience constructing end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and configuring Vertex AI Vector Search for embeddings and semantic search.
  
  
Practical experience designing agentic AI workflows and establishing automated evaluation metrics (“evals”) for enterprise AI applications.
  
  
  

* Client & Leadership Capabilities

Experience in customer-facing roles, driving technical discovery, solutioning, and executive-level technical discussions.
  
  
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a track record of optimizing application performance.
  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, Healthcare, Enterprise SaaS) with strict security and compliance considerations.
  
  
Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-optimization strategies for large-scale GenAI workloads.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & System Design: Architect and implement resilient, scalable, and high-throughput enterprise systems and microservices using GCP-native cloud frameworks.
  
  
GenAI & Agentic Engineering: Build and deploy enterprise GenAI applications leveraging Vertex AI, Gemini API, Vertex AI Vector Search, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Establish automated evaluation loops (“evals”) to measure model performance, drift, and accuracy.
  
  
Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Lead end-to-end delivery—including technical requirement gathering, architectural blueprints, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), production integration, deployment, and performance optimization.
  
  
Cloud & DevOps Orchestration: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and manage containerized microservices across Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the technical authority in direct client engagements, translating business requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps and conducting technical deep dives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guide engineering teams through design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, establish best practices, and drive technical excellence across cross-functional initiatives.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Specialist, Financial Operations
description:
**Transformation Analyst - Agentic Process Transformation**

  
  

*Rights & Royalties Transformation | IC20 | 3-4*
*years experience*

  
  

**Role Focus**

  
  

**Primary Platforms**

  
  

**Success Measure**

  
  

**Domain Advantage**

  
  

Agent creation, workflow automation and process transformation

  
  

Copilot Studio, Power Automate, M365 ecosystem; BI/data tools as enabling skills

  
  

Efficiency gains, cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption and controls

  
  

Rights, royalties, licensing, finance operations and publishing

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.

  
  

Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.

  
  

**Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  
  
* Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  
  
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  
  
* Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.
  

  

**Core Responsibilities**

  
  

**1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis**

  

  
* Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  
  
* Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  
  
* Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
* Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  
  
* Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.
  

  

**2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions**

  

  
* Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  
  
* Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  
  
* Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  
  
* Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  
  
* Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.
  

  

**3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement**

  

  
* Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  
  
* Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  
  
* Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  
  
* Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.
  

  

**4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation**

  

  
* Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.
  
  
* Use dashboards and reporting tools to monitor transformation outcomes, bottlenecks, adoption and benefit delivery.
  
  
* Perform practical analysis to identify trends, anomalies and improvement opportunities related to royalty statements, adjustments, disputes, metadata, reserves, payments or case volumes.
  
  
* Prepare concise executive-ready summaries that convert analysis into business decisions and action plans.
  

  

**5) Governance, Controls & Documentation**

  

  
* Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, decision logs, control points, KPI definitions and adoption materials.
  
  
* Ensure automation and agent assets have clear ownership, change control, traceability, testing evidence and governance alignment.
  
  
* Strengthen audit readiness through reconciliation checkpoints, exception logs, approval matrices and documented process logic.
  

  

**Typical Outcomes / KPIs You May Own**

  

  
* Automation and agent benefit realisation: hours saved, cost avoidance, productivity uplift and reduced manual touchpoints.
  
  
* Cycle-time and SLA improvement across targeted royalty, rights, finance operations or query-management workflows.
  
  
* Reduction in rework, avoidable escalations, duplicate handling, leakage risk and control exceptions.
  
  
* Agent and automation adoption: active users, usage frequency, completion rate, deflection rate, satisfaction and feedback themes.
  
  
* Quality and reliability: successful workflow runs, exception rates, data accuracy, audit trail completeness and refresh reliability.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  

  
* 3-4 years experience in a Business Analyst, Transformation Analyst, Automation Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Operations or comparable role.
  
  
* Strong process discovery and problem-solving capability, with the ability to simplify complex operational work into clear, actionable requirements.
  
  
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, preferably Power Automate and Copilot Studio, or a demonstrable ability to build low-code automations and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
* Ability to define agent or automation use cases, map workflows, document requirements, test outputs, manage feedback and support adoption.
  
  
* Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.
  
  
* Good analytical capability and comfort working with operational data, KPIs and dashboards. Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, BigQuery or similar tools is useful, but not the primary focus of the role.
  
  
* Excellent communication skills: concise documentation, clear visuals, executive-ready summaries and practical training materials.
  
  
* Outcome ownership and delivery pace: able to move from discovery to MVP to adoption with discipline and urgency.
  

  

**Preferred / Advantageous**

  

  
* Exposure to royalties, rights, licensing, publishing/media, revenue-share, finance operations or contract-driven processes.
  
  
* Understanding of the royalty lifecycle: contract terms, rate structures, deductions, reserves, statements, payments, recoupment, audit queries and dispute handling.
  
  
* Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, Teams, Excel-based operations, document repositories or workflow-heavy operational environments.
  
  
* Familiarity with process mapping tools such as Blueworks, Visio or Lucidchart; Lean, continuous improvement or process re-engineering methods.
  
  
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, access control, knowledge-source hygiene and governance considerations for enterprise agents.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business, Operations, IT, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  
  
* Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, PG Diploma in Business Analytics, Operations, Finance or Transformation is a differentiator, not mandatory.
  
  
* Relevant certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, automation, business analysis, Lean/process improvement, data analytics or BI are advantageous.
  

  

**Behavioural**
**Competencies - Non-negotiable for Transformation**

  

  
* Agentic mindset: thinks beyond reporting and looks for ways to remove, automate or augment work.
  
  
* Adaptability, speed and agility:moves quickly from ambiguity to working MVPs and iterates based on feedback.
  
  
* Outcome ownership: focuses on measurable improvement, not activity completion.
  
  
* Structured problem-solving: separates symptoms from root cause and prioritises by business impact and control risk.
  
  
* Precision and control mindset: understands the financial, contractual and audit sensitivity of royalties operations.
  
  
* Collaboration and influence: earns trust across operations and technology, handles competing priorities and drives closure.
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

Works closely with Rights & Royalties Operations, Finance Operations, Transformation leads, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance/Legal and operational leaders. Acts as a process transformation, agent enablement and automation partner to teams looking to improve efficiency, control and customer experience.

  
  

**What This Role Offers**

  

  
* High-visibility transformation scope with measurable business impact in a financially sensitive and globally relevant domain.
  
  
* Opportunity to build modern agentic automation capabilities across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Strong cross-functional exposure across Rights, Royalties, Finance, Product, Technology and Governance teams.
  
  
* A practical platform to convert process knowledge into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer (Senior Consultant) to design, develop, and deploy intelligent agent-based solutions leveraging Microsoft AI technologies. This role focuses on building scalable AI-driven applications and enhancing enterprise processes through automation and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.

* Build, test, and deploy intelligent agents using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. title: Director /AVP - Data Science
description:
**Overview About Ripik.AI**
Ripik.ai is an Accel-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process-optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor — monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.
  
  
We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej & Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East,Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high-velocity scale-up to a category-defining global industrial AI company.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Data Science Manager to lead a team of 6–8 AI — Computer Vision engineers. This is a player-coach role: you will set technical direction, personally solve the hardest modelling problems, and grow a high-performing engineering team — all within the fast-moving environment of a venture-backed industrial AI start-up. Prior formal management experience is not required; what matters is deep technical expertise, the ability to influence through craft, and the drive to build and ship in ambiguous, high-stakes settings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
***Technical Leadership & Hands-on Delivery***

* Own the end-to-end computer vision roadmap — from problem framing and data strategy through model development, edge deployment, and production monitoring — across Ripik’s industrial portfolio (steel, cement, pharma, paints, and beyond).
* Personally architect and build solutions for the most complex vision challenges: novel defect types, extreme class imbalance, multi-camera fusion, low-light / high-noise factory environments, and real-time inference on constrained edge hardware.
* Stay at the cutting edge of CV research and rapidly evaluate and adopt new models and techniques — YOLO26, SAM 3, Vision Transformers (DINOv2, Swin), Grounding DINO, RF-DETR, zero-shot / open-vocabulary detection (YOLO-World, CLIP) — translating papers into production value.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for the vision stack: model training pipelines, data versioning (DVC), annotation workflows (CVAT, Roboflow, Label Studio), experiment tracking (W&B, MLflow), edge export formats (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO), and CI/CD for model updates.
* Drive inference optimisation — quantisation (INT8 / FP16, GPTQ), pruning, knowledge distillation, and batching strategies — to meet latency and cost targets across NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs, and cloud GPU instances.

***Team Building & People Growth***

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 6–8 Computer Vision engineers — set clear goals, run structured code reviews and design reviews, and create an environment of rapid learning and ownership.
* Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar through hands-on pairing, knowledge-sharing sessions, and a culture of experimentation over perfection.
* Manage sprint planning, task prioritisation, and delivery timelines; balance exploratory R&D with committed product deliverables in a fast-paced start-up cadence.
* Act as the primary technical interface between the CV team and cross-functional stakeholders — product, field engineering, operations, and leadership — translating business problems into well-scoped modelling projects and communicating results clearly.

***Innovation & Problem Solving***

* Identify and frame novel, first-of-its-kind vision problems in industrial settings where off-the-shelf approaches fall short; design creative solutions combining classical image processing, deep learning, and domain heuristics.
* Champion a data-centric AI approach — invest in annotation quality, active learning, synthetic data generation, and feedback loops from production rather than only chasing bigger models.
* Establish robust evaluation frameworks: domain-specific metrics, A/B testing against production baselines, and systematic failure-mode analysis to ensure models deliver real business impact.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of hands-on experience in computer vision — with a strong track record of taking models from research / prototyping through to production deployment.
* Deep proficiency in Python and PyTorch; strong working knowledge of OpenCV, Albumentations, and image / video processing fundamentals.
* Demonstrated expertise across multiple CV tasks: object detection, instance / semantic / panoptic segmentation, anomaly detection, pose estimation, or tracking.
* Hands-on experience with modern model families — YOLO (v8 / v11 / v26), transformer-based detectors (RT-DETR, DETR, RF-DETR), segmentation models (SAM / SAM 2), and CNN backbones (ResNet, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, Vision Transformers).
* Production experience deploying models to edge or on-prem hardware using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or OpenVINO; comfort with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where scope is ambiguous, timelines are tight, and wearing multiple hats is the norm.
* Strong first-principles problem-solving ability — comfortable navigating novel, unstructured problems where no playbook exists.
* Excellent communication skills — able to distil complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, write clear documentation, and present results to leadership and customers.

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team (formal management title not required; tech-lead, senior IC, or project-lead experience counts).
* Experience with industrial or manufacturing domains — understanding of factory-floor constraints, camera setups, lighting variability, and integration with PLCs / SCADA systems.
* Familiarity with zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection (Grounding DINO, YOLO-World, CLIP) and foundation models (DINOv2, SAM 3, Florence) for data-efficient learning.
* Exposure to vision–language models (GPT-4o vision, Gemini, LLaVA) for combining visual inspection with natural-language reporting or operator copilots.
* Knowledge of 3D vision, depth estimation, point-cloud processing, or multi-camera calibration for volumetric industrial inspection.
* Experience with multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) and video analytics pipelines for continuous production-line monitoring.
* Contributions to open-source CV projects, publications in top-tier venues (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS), or strong Kaggle competition results.

What Can You Expect?
  
  

* A leadership seat at a high-growth, venture-backed AI start-up — directly shape the technical direction and team culture of the computer vision function.
* Ability to shape the future of manufacturing by leveraging best-in-class AI and software; develop a niche skill set at the intersection of deep learning and heavy industry.
* World-class work culture, coaching, and development.
* Mentoring from highly experienced leadership from world-class companies (refer to Ripik.AI website for details).
* International exposure.

For More Information
  
  

* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YRuz3XxPfcE
* https://www.ripik.ai
* https://www.linkedin.com/company/ripik-ai/

title: System Analyst - Power BI/Python/VBA/R
description:
**Job Description**
At WSP, we're continuing to grow and develop our expertise in Earth and Environment, operating as a trusted advisor and technical expert on engineering design challenges for our clients across multiple industries. Our team is growing, and as a result we're adding a Data Scientist and Visualization Lead to our water quality group. As part of the team in Prairies and North, you'll be responsible for driving forward our ambitious plans to enhance our Earth and Environment service offering in the province through your work with a close-knit team of engineering specialists, professionals, and technical staff.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
A day in the life…
  
  

* Day-to-day, you will work with the water quality team to expand and strengthen our data processing and visualization tools, with opportunities to collaborate with other environmental digitization and database teams within WSP;
* You’ll be part of a company wide initiative to grow our environmental digitization tools to become a market leader in the way that we visualize and analyze large environmental datasets;
* You’ll be proficient in python, VBA, R, and other coding languages, with the ability to interpret and update code from existing tools. You will troubleshoot/update tool functions with support from the technical team;
* You’ll be a leader and innovator in the development of Power BI dashboards used to visualize environmental data on mining projects throughout Canada;
* You’ll be working with a focus group who track water quality guideline updates in Canada, and you will support the team with managing these updates and issuing new versions of our data processing tools based on these guidelines;
* You’ll train and mentor our team in the use of our tools, and present learning opportunities to other groups to expand your professional network;
* Working closely with project teams, you’ll help identify new opportunities to expand the use of our water quality and environmental digitization tools, presenting to clients as needed, and helping troubleshoot and develop tools for project work.

**Qualifications**
We'd love to hear from you if you have...
  
  

* A university degree in environmental sciences, computer science, or software development;
* Environmental data management experience and a related technical background is an asset;
* Effective communication skills with the ability to move projects forward independently, provide training to others on the team on tools, and seek out technical support when needed;
* A track record of using R, python, and VBA to develop data management, assessment, and visualization tools;
* Has a strong understanding of DAX, data modelling patterns and experience sharing reports with external users;
* Experience with ingesting and consolidating data from external sources using Power Quer;
* Are familiar with Microsoft Power Platform and can leverage the M365 environment for operational excellence;
* A desire to stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, machine learning, and data visualization.

title: AI Agent Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
In this role, you will help shape the future of intelligent engineering and power plant operations by developing hands-on AI/ML and agent-based solutions that simplify engineering work, increase productivity, and unlock new operational capabilities.
  
  
You will build intelligent tools and AI agents that automate control logic generation, graphics configuration, reporting, and engineering workflows, enabling plant engineers to focus on higher-value innovation. By analyzing control system and operational data, you will uncover patterns, develop predictive capabilities, and deliver data-driven decision support for real-world power plant environments.
  
  

* Apply AI-based anomaly detection, diagnostics, and decision-support solutions to real power-plant operational challenges.
* Translate plant operating behavior, control logic, alarms, and historian trends into practical AI use cases and agent workflows.
* Work with time-series operational data from DCS/SCADA and plant historians (preferably Emerson Ovation) to identify abnormal patterns, degradation, and performance losses.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing,and reliability teams to validate AI insights against real plant conditions.
* Support development and tuning of AI/analytics models using Python and data tools (focus on application rather than algorithm research).
* Integrate AI outputs into dashboards, alerts, and engineering workflows without impacting plant safety or control integrity.
* Test, validate, and monitor AI solutions in live or near-real plant environments, ensuring reliability and low false-alarm rates.
* Continuously improve AI performance using operational feedback, historical fault data, and domain knowledge.
* Troubleshoot deployed analytics/AI tools and coordinate improvements with software or data teams.

**Who you Are:**
We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, you set ambitious goals and uphold the highest standards in every project.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Control Systems, Power Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2–8 years of experience in coal-fired, combined-cycle, or utility power plants with strong knowledge of plant operations, control processes, and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with DCS platforms, preferably Emerson Ovation, including control logic, alarm management, plant monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of power plant systems such as boilers, turbines, generators, combustion controls, and balance-of-plant operations.
* Experience developing AI-powered applications using Python, including data processing, API integration, and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.
* Ability to translate power plant operational knowledge and procedures into AI Agent use cases and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, and software development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications That Make You Stand Out:**

* Experience with Emerson Ovation DCS or other power plant control systems (ABB, Honeywell, Siemens, GE, Yokogawa).
* Hands-on experience developing AI Agents, operator assistants, troubleshooting tools, or knowledge management solutions for industrial applications.
* Knowledge of machine learning, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and time-series analytics.
* Familiarity with vector databases, cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and industrial data integration.
* Passion for applying AI and automation technologies to improve power plant operations, reliability, and performance.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
  
  
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
  
  
At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.
  
  
**Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation**
If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .
  
  
**About Emerson**
Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
  
  
With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
  
  
We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

title: Senior AI Technologist
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
The AI Technologist – Autonomous Networks designs, builds and industrialises AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI solutions for network managed services and network intelligence. The role applies advanced AI to large-scale telecom and IT data, develops production-grade models, pipelines and digital-engineer agents, and collaborates with AI Domain Solution Leaders, architects and product teams to deliver scalable, secure and trustworthy solutions for Ericsson and its customers.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Identify and lead AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI opportunities across Ericsson businesses and strategic customers.
* Define data science problem statements, model validation strategies and measurable business outcomes.
* Design data architectures, data flows, feature engineering approaches and ML, deep learning, GenAI and agentic AI architectures.
* Develop and deploy predictive, anomaly detection, recommendation, root-cause and other AI/ML solutions using large-scale 4G/5G/5G-Advanced, IoT and OSS/BSS data.
* Design and implement GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration and autonomous or assisted digital-engineer workflows for network operations.
* Lead PoCs and MVPs from problem definition and data exploration through production deployment and monitoring.
* Industrialise AI solutions with product teams through production-grade code, APIs, workflows and documentation.
* Build scalable data pipelines and storage/retrieval solutions for structured and unstructured data, including KPIs, logs, text and images.
* Own the MLOps lifecycle covering training, deployment, serving, monitoring, evaluation and model lifecycle management.
* Integrate AI models with network automation applications and Ericsson platforms through standard APIs and automation interfaces.
* Apply trustworthy-AI principles, guardrails, explainability, security and human-in-the-loop controls for safe deployment in live networks.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years of production-level AI/ML experience, with hands-on GenAI and/or agentic AI development.
* Proven experience taking AI/ML and GenAI solutions from problem definition to production, including LLM assistants, RAG and AI agents.
* Strong programming and software-engineering skills with modern AI/ML and deep-learning frameworks, APIs, version control, testing and CI/CD.
* Strong knowledge of MLOps, SDLC, observability, security, model evaluation, configuration management and production readiness.
* Practical experience with the GCP AI ecosystem, including Vertex AI, Gemini, ADK, Agent Engine/Runtime, Model Garden, vector search, BigQuery, Spanner, Knowledge Catalog and Agent Gateway.
* Strong understanding of agentic AI architecture, including orchestration, agent harnesses, A2A, MCP, memory management, context engineering and token/cost optimisation.
* Hands-on expertise in data engineering, pipelines, big-data processing, storage, indexing, partitioning and retrieval.
* Telecommunications or IoT experience, particularly 4G/5G, OSS/BSS, network automation or network intelligence, is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate complex business and network challenges into practical AI solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong customer and value orientation, collaboration, creativity, ownership and ability to drive complex initiatives to completion.
* Experience with AI/ML communities, technical publications, white papers, conferences or patents is a plus.

title: Data Science & AI Lead
description:
Data Science & AI Lead

**Advanced Analytics & AI | Grade 8**

Department : Group Data & AI

Vertical :Advanced Analytics & AI

Grade :8

Level :Lead (HR Grade: Manager)

Reports To :Senior Manager – Advanced Analytics & AI

Location :Hybrid – Dubai and Abu Dhabi, as required by the business and leadership.

Travel :This role may require travel across relevant markets and delivery locations.

Experience :8–12 years

Context

AI capabilities are already being applied across areas such as customer service automation, vision-based plant safety monitoring, and commercial AI through technology partnerships. This vertical will scale these capabilities and build an advanced analytics and AI portfolio that creates measurable value across revenue growth management, supply chain, manufacturing, and enterprise productivity.

Role Purpose

This is a senior hands-on expert role responsible for building solutions, reviewing technical work, and leading a small team while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

The role operates through short, iterative cycles, with an emphasis on delivering working outputs early.

Value Creation Accountability

Every role in this function is accountable for value created, not activity delivered. For this role, that means:

* Every model should be tied to a decision that improves and a measurable business outcome, with a clearly identified beneficiary.
* Instrument solutions so benefits are measurable and build for reuse so future deployments cost less.
* Own the value case for the assigned area: sponsor, baseline, and target benefit agreed before work begins, with benefits reported after delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Use-Case Portfolio & Value

* Own the AI and advanced analytics portfolio, including identification, sizing, prioritisation, and benefit tracking with business sponsors.
* Agree benefit measurement with Finance before work starts; report validated benefit rather than self-declared benefit.
* Review the portfolio regularly and scale, pause, or stop use cases based on evidence.

Commercial & RGM Analytics

* Deliver Revenue Growth Management analytics, including price-pack architecture, price elasticity, price and trade promotion optimisation, and trade spend return.
* Build toward AI-supported price and mix optimisation, assortment, and channel analytics across business units and GCC markets.
* Partner closely with commercial leadership so models inform real pricing and promotion decisions.

Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Operations AI

* Deliver demand forecasting, inventory and replenishment optimisation, and route optimisation.
* Build cost-to-serve optimisation and distribution analytics to improve margin per customer and channel.
* Deliver manufacturing and quality use cases, including predictive maintenance, yield and waste reduction, quality prediction, and cold-chain analytics.

GenAI, Agents & Responsible AI

* Scale Generative AI across the enterprise, including assistants, document and contract intelligence, and function-level automation.
* Design and deploy AI agents that automate workflows and drive measurable efficiency across business and support functions.
* Establish MLOps, including experiment tracking, model registry, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and retraining.
* Define and enforce Responsible AI controls, including approved use-case registers, human oversight, bias and performance reviews, and model documentation.

Leading Others

* Lead a small team of Seniors, ICs, and Specialists, allocating work, reviewing quality, and developing capability.
* Direct offshore and vendor resources working within the assigned area.
* Set and enforce technical standards through review and practical implementation.

Stakeholder & Delivery Management

* Build trusted relationships with business unit and corporate function leaders and understand how each business makes money and decisions.
* Own initiatives end to end, from problem definition and business case development through delivery, adoption, and benefit realisation.
* Apply product management discipline with a defined backlog prioritised by value and a named business owner for every deliverable.
* Run delivery transparently with clear plans, visible progress, early escalation of risks and dependencies, and honest reporting of delays.
* Direct vendor and offshore resources and influence stakeholders to secure data ownership and adoption.
* Present confidently to senior leadership, translating technical topics into business language and clear recommendations.

Qualifications & Experience

* 8–12 years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or AI Engineering.
* Proven experience taking models from prototype into production with measurable business benefits.
* Practical enterprise GenAI delivery experience, including RAG, assistants, agents, evaluation, and guardrails.
* Exposure to RGM, pricing, forecasting, supply chain, or manufacturing analytics within retail, FMCG, or a comparable sector.
* Demonstrated senior-level stakeholder management and end-to-end project or product management experience, from business case through adoption and benefit realisation.
* Experience directing vendors, partners, or offshore delivery resources.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a quantitative discipline, or related field. Relevant cloud and data certifications are preferred.
* Experience within the GCC or a multi-entity, multi-country organisation is an advantage. Arabic language skills are beneficial but not mandatory.

Technical Skills

* Python and ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with strong SQL.
* Databricks, including Mosaic AI, MLflow, Feature Store, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Spark for scaled processing.
* Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, including LLM application patterns, agent frameworks, evaluation, and cost control.
* Forecasting, optimisation, elasticity, and experimentation methods.
* MLOps and software engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, containers, APIs, and CI/CD.
* Power BI or Fabric integration to surface model outputs.
* Cloud data environments, with Azure strongly preferred; AWS or GCP experience considered.
* Experience working across ERP, sales/POS, supply chain, manufacturing, and HR source systems.
* Strong understanding of visualisation and BI tooling, with Power BI preferred; Tableau or Qlik considered.
* Advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills.
* Working knowledge of data governance, master data concepts, and associated tooling.
* Familiarity with delivering data, analytics, or AI as products that are versioned, documented, and continuously improved.

Key Competencies

* Value-creation mindset, starting from the business outcome and working backwards to the solution.
* Strong team player who collaborates effectively across verticals and locations.
* Positive and proactive approach with the ability to create momentum in a developing function.
* Strong problem-solving and ownership mindset.
* Hands-on and agile, with the ability to build directly, work in short increments, and adapt to feedback.
* Comfortable working in a greenfield environment where standards and processes are still evolving.
* Confident communicator with senior stakeholders, equally comfortable leading technical reviews and business-value discussions.

What Success Looks Like

* Priority use cases moved into production with measurable benefits validated with Finance.
* RGM analytics supporting live pricing and promotion decisions.
* GenAI and agent-based automation delivering measurable efficiency within at least one business function.
* MLOps operating effectively, with models deployable and retrainable without vendor dependency.

title: Intermediate Professional, Digital Solutions
description:

WSP is seeking an AI Engineer to develop and support production-oriented Generative AI solutions for the Middle East AI portfolio from the Bengaluru GCC. The role will work across AI products, agents, automation workflows and enterprise integrations, with emphasis on secure engineering, measurable quality and responsible AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop GenAI applications, agents and automation workflows using approved designs and engineering standards.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, structured outputs and prompt patterns to improve solution reliability and usability.
* Integrate AI components with enterprise systems, APIs, approved vector search services and governed data sources.
* Build and maintain ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured content.
* Create evaluation datasets and execute repeatable testing for accuracy, grounding, safety, latency and solution quality.
* Apply responsible AI controls including validation, guardrails, content filtering, traceability and human oversight.
* Develop clean, reusable and well-documented Python components and participate in code reviews.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.

title: Digital - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 4\-8 years of overall experience to design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on expertise in Python, Generative AI and Agentic AI, backed by a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Transformer architectures. This is a hands\-on role where you will be expected to operate as a strong individual contributor while also being able to work at a lead capacity, engaging directly stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own features end\-to\-end, from problem framing and model development to API design, deployment, and scaling on the cloud.
* Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Design and develop REST/APIs and integrate AI models into services.
* Scale applications and optimize performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Deploy and operate models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
* Operate as a strong individual contributor and lead at a stakeholder engagement capacity.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\-8 years of overall hands\-on experience in software/AI engineering (not limited to Generative AI).
* Proven track record of delivering production\-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Very strong proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine\-tuning).
* Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and techniques.
* Good working knowledge of NLP and Transformer\-based architectures.
* Production\-grade experience designing and developing REST/APIs and integrating AI models into services.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling applications and optimizing performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* Experience in deploying and operating models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Hands\-on experience building Agentic AI systems (multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, autonomous workflows).
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.
* Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to Azure AI/OpenAI services, Azure ML, and serverless deployments.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.


**What We Look For**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery\-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data & Recon Team Lead
description:

* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities.

* Bachelor’s \& master's in finance or accounting.
* 9\+ years of relevant experience in leading a cross\-functional and collaborative team.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience leading an operational team in a relevant industry\- finance, accounting, or tech.

title: AI Safety & Evaluation Lead
description:
Role Overview: As the AI Safety \& Evaluation Lead, you will ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, unbiased, secure, and compliant. With students as the primary users, you will focus on student psychology, content safety, and handling sensitive queries in an age\-appropriate manner. This is a 0\-to\-1 role requiring high ownership, hands\-on execution, adaptability, and comfort with ambiguity and fast\-paced work.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own AI evaluation frameworks, including automated, human\-in\-the\-loop, and benchmark testing.
* Lead red\-teaming, adversarial testing, and vulnerability identification across AI models.
* Define AI safety, responsible AI, bias, fairness, and child\-safe content standards.
* Build and maintain evaluation tools using platforms such as RAGAS, LangSmith, PromptBench, and LMEval.
* Conduct bias, fairness, hallucination, grounding, and response\-quality assessments across languages and regions.
* Manage AI risk assessments and translate findings into actionable model or prompt improvements.
* Establish AI governance documentation, audit trails, and safety reports.
* Embed evaluation and safety checks into AI release pipelines with engineering teams.
* Track relevant AI governance and regulatory frameworks, including NIST AI RMF and India/EU AI regulations.



 Requirements
 


* Strong experience in AI/LLM safety, evaluation, and risk assessment.
* Expertise in model evaluation, red\-teaming, and adversarial testing.
* Strong understanding of bias, fairness, hallucination, grounding, and content safety.
* Experience working with production AI/LLM systems and evaluation tools.
* Knowledge of AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
* Understanding of student psychology and age\-appropriate AI output design.

title: Actuarial Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**
 The role supports actuarial valuation and financial reporting activities for Asia life insurance businesses across multiple accounting and regulatory frameworks. The incumbent will work closely with local offices, finance, and global stakeholders to deliver accurate reserve calculations, IFRS 17 reporting, and related actuarial analyses.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform US GAAP (US GAAP), US STAT, and Local Statutory valuations for life insurance products
* Support IFRS 17 reporting, including ongoing reporting and implementation / enhancement activities
* Assist with risk\-based capital, solvency regime, and regulatory reporting requirements
* Conduct experience studies (mortality, lapse, expenses, etc.) and support assumption setting
* Analyze and explain movements in reserves and financial results
* Prepare and maintain actuarial documentation, methodologies, and audit support materials
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Finance, IT, and external consultants
* Ensure accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of actuarial outputs


**Technical Skills**

description:
